name: moonshot-integration-tests
description: Integration tests for Moonshot CI/CD using Playwright

scripts.test:dev-script: npm run build && playwright test tests/run_dev_script.spec.js
scripts.test:dev-script:headed: npm run build && playwright test tests/run_dev_script.spec.js --headed
scripts.test:dev-script:debug: npm run build && playwright test tests/run_dev_script.spec.js --debug
scripts.test:example: npm run build && playwright test tests/example.spec.js
scripts.test:example:headed: npm run build && playwright test tests/example.spec.js --headed
